---
title: "html: layout panels"
format: html
# A Div with `layout-ncol`, `layout-nrow` or `layout` becomes a
# `quarto-layout-panel` of `quarto-layout-row` Divs, each holding
# `quarto-layout-cell` Divs whose width is an inline `flex-basis` (Quarto 1
# `layout/layout.lua` and `layout/html.lua`). Cases taken from Quarto 1's
# panel fixtures (smoke-all/2024/03/14/9076.qmd, 2024/01/09/8187.qmd,
# crossrefs/float/multirow-layout.qmd): rows from a column count, rows from a
# row count, a `layout` with relative widths and a spacer, alignment, a
# figure div that keeps its caption, and a code cell whose source moves in
# front of the panel.
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'div#ncol.quarto-layout-panel[data-layout-ncol="2"] > div.quarto-layout-row:only-child > div.quarto-layout-cell[style="flex-basis: 50.0%;justify-content: flex-start;"]:nth-child(2)'
          - 'div#ncol div.quarto-layout-cell > div.quarto-figure > figure'
          - 'div#three > div.quarto-layout-row:nth-child(2) > div.quarto-layout-cell[style="flex-basis: 33.3%;justify-content: flex-start;"]:nth-child(2):last-child'
          - 'div#nrow > div.quarto-layout-row:nth-child(2):last-child > div.quarto-layout-cell:nth-child(2):last-child'
          - 'div#custom > div.quarto-layout-row:first-child > div.quarto-figure-spacer.quarto-layout-cell[style="flex-basis: 20.0%;justify-content: flex-start;"]:nth-child(2)'
          - 'div#custom > div.quarto-layout-row:first-child > div.quarto-layout-cell[style="flex-basis: 40.0%;justify-content: flex-start;"]:nth-child(3)'
          - 'div#custom > div.quarto-layout-row:nth-child(2) > div.quarto-layout-cell[style="flex-basis: 100.0%;justify-content: flex-start;"]:only-child'
          - 'div#aligned > div.quarto-layout-row.quarto-layout-valign-bottom > div.quarto-layout-cell[style="flex-basis: 30.0%;justify-content: flex-end;"]'
          - 'div#aligned > div.quarto-layout-row > div.quarto-layout-cell[style="flex-basis: 70.0%;justify-content: flex-end;"]'
          - 'div#bare div.quarto-layout-cell[style="flex-basis: 50.0%;justify-content: center;"] > p > img'
          - 'div#bare div.quarto-layout-cell[style="flex-basis: 50.0%;justify-content: center;"] > table'
          - 'div#divs > div.quarto-layout-row > div.one.quarto-layout-cell'
          - 'div#fig-pair.quarto-layout-panel > figure.quarto-float > div > div.quarto-layout-row > div.quarto-layout-cell:nth-child(2)'
          - 'div#fig-pair > figure > figcaption'
          - 'div.cell.quarto-layout-panel > div.quarto-layout-row > div.quarto-layout-cell:nth-child(2) > p > img'
        - - 'div#aligned[data-layout-valign]'
          - 'div#fig-pair[data-layout-ncol]'
          - 'div.quarto-layout-panel div.cell-code'
          - 'div.quarto-layout-panel pre'
          - 'div.quarto-layout-cell > div.quarto-layout-cell'
      ensureCssRegexMatches:
        - - '\.quarto-layout-row\s*\{[^}]*display:\s*flex'
          - '\.quarto-layout-cell\s*\{[^}]*margin-right:\s*20px'
        - []
---
